meta.name: ai-cold-email
meta.description: 冷邮件诊断助手适合销售、市场营销、运营、software在用户提出“客户为什么不回我”这类问题，需要快速拆解目标、判断重点并形成可执行结果时使用，帮助基于输入材料生成转化问题优先级、可复制改稿、实验或跟进行动清单。

copy.tagline: 诊断冷邮件问题并生成改稿与跟进清单
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常发冷邮件但回复率低，需要快速诊断并优化策略。
copy.tagline_en: Diagnose cold email issues and generate rewrite and follow-up actions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often send cold emails with low reply rates and need quick diagnosis and optimization.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会分析你提供的客户资料、沟通记录或邮件草稿，输出转化问题优先级、可复制的改稿建议、实验方案或跟进行动清单。
howto.when: 当你提出“客户为什么不回我”这类问题，或需要围绕冷邮件优化生成可执行结果时触发。

say.text: 客户一直不回复我的邮件，帮我分析一下原因。
say.note: Claude 会要求你提供客户资料或邮件草稿。

say.text: 帮我优化这封冷邮件，提高回复率。
say.note: 粘贴邮件草稿后，Claude 会给出改稿建议。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude analyzes your customer data, communication records, or email drafts, and outputs conversion issue priorities, replicable copy revisions, experiments, or follow-up action checklists.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask "Why don't customers reply to me?" or need actionable results for cold email optimization.

say_en.text: Customers never reply to my emails. Help me analyze why.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for customer data or email drafts.

say_en.text: Help me optimize this cold email to improve reply rate.
say_en.note: Paste the draft; Claude will suggest revisions.
